tools.name: list_space_templates
tools.title: Search space templates
tools.description: Retrieve the list of available Space Templates with their basic information.

query.description: Keyword search across space names and descriptions

tools.name: get_space_template_by_id
tools.title: Get a space template
tools.description: Retrieve a Space Template using its technical identifier.

tools.name: create_space
tools.title: Create a space
tools.description: Creates a new Space for the current user based on a template. IMPORTANT: to create a SUB-SPACE under an existing space, you MUST set parent_space_id to that parent space's id (first look it up with get_my_spaces or get_all_spaces). Creating a space without parent_space_id always makes a TOP-LEVEL space, even if the user asked for a sub-space. A sub-space can only be created when the parent space's template explicitly allows it.

space_template_id.description: Template ID of the space (required). Use 'listSpaceTemplates' Tool to find valid IDs and Search for a Space Template by its name.

name.description: User-facing display name of the space

registration.description: How users can join the space

parent_space_id.description: Identifier of the parent space, REQUIRED to create a sub-space (7.2 hierarchy). Set this whenever the user asks for a 'sub-space of X' / a space 'under X' — resolve X's id first via get_my_spaces or get_all_spaces. Omit only for a genuine top-level space.

tools.name: update_space_settings
tools.title: Update a space settings
tools.description: Update the settings of an existing Space.

space_id.description: Identifier of the Space to update

tools.name: get_all_spaces
tools.title: Search in all spaces
tools.description: Search in all accessible spaces for the user from Spaces Directory.

tools.name: get_my_spaces
tools.title: Search in my spaces
tools.description: Retrieve the list of spaces where the current user is a member.

tools.name: get_managed_spaces
tools.title: Search in spaces I manage
tools.description: Retrieve the list of spaces where the current user is a manager.

tools.name: get_space_by_id
tools.title: Get a space
tools.description: Retrieve full details of a Space by its unique identifier.

tools.name: list_users_of_space_by_role
tools.title: List space members
tools.description: Retrieve the list of users in a Space by role.

tools.name: invite_users_to_space
tools.title: Invite user to space
tools.description: Invite one or more users to join a Space as members.

tools.name: remove_users_from_space
tools.title: Remove user from space
tools.description: Remove one or more users from a Space.

tools.name: set_user_role_in_space
tools.title: Promote user in space
tools.description: Assign or promote a role for a confirmed member of a Space.

tools.name: remove_user_role_in_space
tools.title: Remove user role from space
tools.description: Remove a specific role from a user in a Space.

tools.name: get_my_user_information
tools.title: Get curent user info
tools.description: Provides the identity and profile information of the currently connected user.

tools.name: get_user_by_username
tools.title: Get a user info
tools.description: Provides identity and profile information of a user by username.

username.description: The username to use in search query

tools.name: search_users
tools.title: Search for users
tools.description: Search for users across the platform by an optional keyword.

tools.name: get_users_count
tools.title: Count users
tools.description: Retrieves the users count.

tools.name: search_activities
tools.title: Search for activities
tools.description: Search activities (Also Known As 'posts'), with optional filters for query text, space and favorites.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.title: Get space activities
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of activities (Also Known As 'posts') in a space (or all activities if space_id is null).

tools.name: get_activities_since_days
tools.title: Get activities of last days
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of activities (Also Known As 'posts') in a space (or all activities if space_id is null). This will return the posted activities since the number of designated 'days'.

tools.name: get_user_activity_stream
tools.title: Get a user's activity stream
tools.description: Retrieve the activities (Also Known As 'posts') on a given user's profile stream, filtered to what the current user is allowed to see.

username.description: Username whose activity stream to retrieve

tools.name: get_activity
tools.title: Get an activity
tools.description: Get a single activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: get_activity_comment
tools.title: Get an activity comment
tools.description: Get a specific comment on an activity.

tools.name: create_activity
tools.title: Post an activity
tools.description: Create a new activity (Also Known As 'post') in a space activity stream (or personal activity stream if space_id is null).

tools.name: create_activity_with_image
tools.title: Post an activity with an image
tools.description: Create an activity (post) in a space (or the personal stream if space_id is null) and attach an image to it. The image comes from either a public image URL or base64-encoded bytes (e.g. a screenshot). Use create_activity when no image is needed.

image_url.description: Direct http(s) URL of an image to attach. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (png, jpeg, gif or webp), optionally as a data: URI. Use for a locally-produced image such as a screenshot; prefer image_url when the image is reachable by URL. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility description of the image.

tools.name: attach_image_to_activity
tools.title: Attach an image to an activity
tools.description: Attach an image to an existing activity (post) that the current user is allowed to edit. The image comes from either a public image URL or base64-encoded bytes (e.g. a screenshot).

image_url.description: Direct http(s) URL of an image to attach. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (png, jpeg, gif or webp), optionally as a data: URI. Use for a locally-produced image such as a screenshot; prefer image_url when the image is reachable by URL. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility description of the image.

tools.name: update_activity
tools.title: Update an activity
tools.description: Update an existing activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: delete_activity
tools.title: Delete an activity
tools.description: Delete an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: pin_activity
tools.title: Pin an activity in stream
tools.description: Pin an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID in the stream UI.

tools.name: unpin_activity
tools.title: Unpin an activity from stream
tools.description: Unpin an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: get_activity_comments
tools.title: Get activity comments
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of comments for an activity (Also Known As 'post').

tools.name: create_activity_comment
tools.title: Post an activity comment
tools.description: Add a new activity's comment to an activity.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.title: Update an activity comment
tools.description: Update an existing activity's comment by its ID.

tools.name: share_activity_to_space
tools.title: Share an activity to a space
tools.description: Share an activity (Also Known As 'post') to another space.

tools.name: get_activity_likers
tools.title: Get activity likers
tools.description: Get a paginated list of users who liked an activity (Also Known As 'post').

tools.name: like_the_activity
tools.title: Like an activity
tools.description: Like an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: unlike_the_activity
tools.title: Un-like an activity
tools.description: Remove your like from an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: get_category_tree
tools.title: Get the contents categorization tree
tools.description: get the available categories tree (including sub categories) which can be associated any type of content identified by its technical identifier. The returned category will describe either current user can manage contents association to the category (add/remove contents to the category) through the attribute `can_add_content`.

tools.name: get_categories_of_content
tools.title: Get categories of a content
tools.description: get the associated categories to a designated content. The returned category will describe either current user can manage contents association to the category (add/remove contents to the category) through the attribute `can_add_content`.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: add_content_to_category
tools.title: Associate  a category to a content
tools.description: Add a content into a category. The current user must have the permission (see `can_add_content` attribute in the category) to be able to make the operation on his/her behalf.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: remove_content_from_category
tools.title: Remove a category to a content
tools.description: Removes a content from an associated category. The current user must have the permission (see `can_add_content` attribute in the category) to be able to make the operation on his/her behalf.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List my notifications
tools.description: Retrieve the current user's web notifications, most recent first. Optionally return only unread ones or filter by a notification plugin type (see get_notification_settings for valid plugin ids).

only_unread.description: When true, return only unread notifications

plugin.description: Optional notification plugin/type id to filter on

tools.name: get_unread_notifications_count
tools.title: Count my unread notifications
tools.description: Get the current user's total unread web notifications badge count, plus the unread count broken down by notification plugin/type.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.title: Mark a notification as read
tools.description: Mark a single web notification of the current user as read.

notification_id.description: Identifier of the notification to mark as read

tools.name: mark_all_notifications_read
tools.title: Mark all notifications as read
tools.description: Mark all of the current user's web notifications as read. Optionally restrict to a single notification plugin/type id.

plugin.description: Optional notification plugin/type id to restrict the operation to

tools.name: hide_notification
tools.title: Dismiss a notification
tools.description: Hide/dismiss a single web notification of the current user from the notifications popover.

notification_id.description: Identifier of the notification to hide

tools.name: get_notification_settings
tools.title: Get my notification settings
tools.description: Retrieve the current user's notification settings: available channels with their enabled state, per-plugin enabled channels, and the list of muted space identifiers.

tools.name: set_notification_channel_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable a notification channel
tools.description: Enable or disable a whole notification channel (for example WEB_CHANNEL or MAIL_CHANNEL) for the current user. Use get_notification_settings to list valid channel ids.

channel_id.description: Channel id, e.g. WEB_CHANNEL or MAIL_CHANNEL

enabled.description: Whether the channel should be enabled (true) or disabled (false)

tools.name: set_notification_plugin_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable a notification type on a channel
tools.description: Enable or disable a specific notification plugin/type on a given channel for the current user. Use get_notification_settings to list valid plugin and channel ids.

channel_id.description: Channel id, e.g. WEB_CHANNEL or MAIL_CHANNEL

enabled.description: Whether the plugin should be enabled (true) or disabled (false) on the channel

tools.name: mute_space_notifications
tools.title: Mute or unmute a space
tools.description: Mute or unmute notifications from a given space for the current user.

space_id.description: Identifier of the space to mute or unmute

muted.description: true to mute the space, false to unmute it

tools.name: list_connection_requests
tools.title: List received connection requests
tools.description: List the pending incoming connection (network) requests the current user has received and can accept or refuse.

tools.name: list_sent_connection_requests
tools.title: List sent connection requests
tools.description: List the pending outgoing connection (network) requests the current user has sent and that are awaiting the other person's approval.

tools.name: list_my_connections
tools.title: List my connections
tools.description: List the current user's confirmed connections (their network), optionally filtered by a keyword on the connection's name.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter connections by name

tools.name: list_user_connections
tools.title: List a user's connections
tools.description: List the confirmed connections (network) of a given user by username.

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.title: Get connection status with a user
tools.description: Return the connection status between the current user and a given user: CONFIRMED, PENDING (a request exists either way, direction isn't distinguished), IGNORED or NOT_CONNECTED.

username.description: Username to check the connection status with

tools.name: list_connection_suggestions
tools.title: List connection suggestions
tools.description: List suggested people to connect with for the current user, based on common connections.

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to retrieve

tools.name: send_connection_request
tools.title: Send a connection request
tools.description: Send a connection (network) request from the current user to another user by username.

username.description: Username to send the connection request to

tools.name: accept_connection_request
tools.title: Accept a connection request
tools.description: Accept a pending incoming connection request from a given user. Use list_connection_requests to find valid usernames.

username.description: Username whose connection request to accept

tools.name: refuse_connection_request
tools.title: Refuse a connection request
tools.description: Refuse/decline a pending incoming connection request from a given user.

username.description: Username whose connection request to refuse

tools.name: remove_connection
tools.title: Remove a connection
tools.description: Remove an existing connection between the current user and a given user (disconnect).

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.title: Update my profile
tools.description: Update the current user's own profile fields. Only the provided fields are changed; omit a field to leave it unchanged.

phones.description: Contact phone number to display on the profile

urls.description: One or more personal/professional website urls, comma-separated. Replaces the current list; pass an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: add_work_experience
tools.title: Add a work experience
tools.description: Add a work experience to the current user's profile. 'company' is required; other fields are optional.

start_date.description: Start date in ISO format yyyy-MM-dd (e.g. 2020-01-15)

end_date.description: End date in ISO format yyyy-MM-dd. Omit (or set is_current=true) for an ongoing experience.

is_current.description: True if this is the user's current (ongoing) experience; when true any end_date is cleared.

tools.name: update_work_experience
tools.title: Update a work experience
tools.description: Update an existing work experience of the current user. Only the supplied fields are changed; omit a field to leave it unchanged. Call get_my_user_information first to get the experience_id.

experience_id.description: Id of the experience to update. Call get_my_user_information first to get the experience_id.

start_date.description: Start date in ISO format yyyy-MM-dd (e.g. 2020-01-15)

end_date.description: End date in ISO format yyyy-MM-dd. Omit (or set is_current=true) for an ongoing experience.

is_current.description: True if this is the user's current (ongoing) experience; when true any end_date is cleared.

tools.name: remove_work_experience
tools.title: Remove a work experience
tools.description: Remove a work experience from the current user's profile. Call get_my_user_information first to get the experience_id.

experience_id.description: Id of the experience to remove. Call get_my_user_information first to get the experience_id.

tools.name: set_profile_field_visibility
tools.title: Set profile field visibility
tools.description: Hide or show one of the current user's own profile fields. field_name must be one of the toggleable fields returned by get_profile_field_visibility; call it first to get valid names. Some fields (like the full name) can't be hidden.

field_name.description: Exact technical name of the profile field to toggle. Must be one of the toggleable_fields returned by get_profile_field_visibility.

hidden.description: True to hide the field from other users, false to make it visible again.

tools.name: get_profile_field_visibility
tools.title: Get hidden profile fields
tools.description: List the current user's profile field visibility: returns which fields are hidden AND the list of fields you can toggle (their exact field_name values and current hidden state). Call this before set_profile_field_visibility.

tools.name: get_user_online_status
tools.title: Get a user's online status
tools.description: Return whether a given user is currently online, their presence status, and the time of their last activity.

username.description: Username to check the online status of

tools.name: list_online_users
tools.title: List online users
tools.description: List users who are currently online, with their presence status and last activity time.

tools.name: join_space
tools.title: Join a space
tools.description: Join a space directly as the current user. Only works for spaces whose registration is open. For spaces requiring validation use request_to_join_space.

space_id.description: Identifier of the space to join

tools.name: request_to_join_space
tools.title: Request to join a space
tools.description: Send a request to join a space that requires manager validation. If the space is open the current user is added directly.

space_id.description: Identifier of the space to request to join

tools.name: cancel_join_request
tools.title: Cancel a join request
tools.description: Cancel the current user's own pending request to join a space.

tools.name: leave_space
tools.title: Leave a space
tools.description: Leave a space the current user is a member of. Fails if the current user is the only manager.

space_id.description: Identifier of the space to leave

tools.name: accept_space_invitation
tools.title: Accept a space invitation
tools.description: Accept an invitation the current user has received to join a space.

space_id.description: Identifier of the space the current user was invited to

tools.name: decline_space_invitation
tools.title: Decline a space invitation
tools.description: Decline an invitation the current user has received to join a space.

space_id.description: Identifier of the space the current user was invited to

tools.name: list_space_join_requests
tools.title: List pending join requests
tools.description: List the users who have requested to join a space and are awaiting validation. The current user must be a manager of the space.

tools.name: accept_space_join_request
tools.title: Accept a join request
tools.description: Approve a user's pending request to join a space, adding them as a member. The current user must be a manager of the space.

username.description: Username whose join request to approve

tools.name: decline_space_join_request
tools.title: Decline a join request
tools.description: Reject a user's pending request to join a space. The current user must be a manager of the space.

username.description: Username whose join request to reject

tools.name: get_space_members
tools.title: Get space members with roles
tools.description: List the members of a space, each annotated with their roles in that space (MANAGER, REDACTOR, PUBLISHER, MEMBER).

tools.name: list_sub_spaces
tools.title: List sub-spaces
tools.description: List the sub-spaces (child spaces in the 7.2 hierarchy) of a given parent space that are accessible to the current user.

tools.name: delete_space
tools.title: Delete a space
tools.description: Permanently delete a space and all its content. The current user must be a manager of the space. This is irreversible.

space_id.description: Identifier of the space to delete

tools.name: get_my_settings
tools.title: Get my settings
tools.description: Retrieve the current user's personal settings: preferred language, timezone and presence status.

tools.name: list_available_languages
tools.title: List available languages
tools.description: List the languages available on the platform, with their code (e.g. en, fr) and display label. Use this to find a valid code before calling set_my_language.

tools.name: set_my_language
tools.title: Set my language
tools.description: Set the current user's preferred interface language. The language code must be one of the platform's available languages (see list_available_languages).

tools.name: set_my_timezone
tools.title: Set my timezone
tools.description: Set the current user's timezone, used to display dates and times.

tools.name: set_my_status
tools.title: Set my presence status
tools.description: Set the current user's presence status (online availability).

status.description: Presence status: AVAILABLE (online), AWAY, DO_NOT_DISTURB, INVISIBLE, OFFLINE

tools.name: add_to_favorites
tools.title: Add content to my favorites
tools.description: Mark a content as favorite for the current user. Favoritable content types include: activity, space, note, news, task, event, file. Use the object's technical type and id (e.g. from expressions like /{content_type}:{content_id}).

content_type.description: Content type, e.g. activity, space, note, news, task, event, file

tools.name: remove_from_favorites
tools.title: Remove content from my favorites
tools.description: Remove a content from the current user's favorites.

content_type.description: Content type, e.g. activity, space, note, news, task, event, file

tools.name: is_content_favorite
tools.title: Check if content is a favorite
tools.description: Check whether a given content is currently in the current user's favorites.

content_type.description: Content type, e.g. activity, space, note, news, task, event, file

tools.name: list_my_favorites
tools.title: List my favorites
tools.description: List the current user's favorite contents, optionally filtered by content type. Returns each favorite's content type and id.

content_type.description: Optional content type to filter by, e.g. activity, note, task

tools.name: get_content_tags
tools.title: Get a content's tags
tools.description: List the tags (hashtags) associated with a given content, e.g. an activity or a note.

tools.name: search_tags
tools.title: Search tags
tools.description: Search existing tags by a keyword, to discover tags in use (autocomplete). Returns matching tag names.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to retrieve

tools.name: get_contents_by_tag
tools.title: Get contents by tag
tools.description: Find contents that carry a given tag. Defaults to activities; pass content_type to look up another type (e.g. note).

content_type.description: Content type to look up, defaults to 'activity'

tools.name: get_platform_info
tools.title: Get platform information
tools.description: Retrieve general information about the Meeds platform: name, version, edition, base URL, total number of users and spaces, and the default language.
